subject.title: feat(gateway): pre-handshake origin gate for browser WebSocket clients

question: Should the Gateway adopt the pre-handshake Origin gate only after it shares the full current `isLocalDirectRequest` locality contract, including non-local Host and proxy-header handling?
rationale: The desired security boundary is a maintainer decision because this PR changes when browser-origin failures occur, while the concrete locality mismatch must be repaired to avoid weakening the existing policy.

options.title: Port the canonical locality contract
options.body: Replace the reduced loopback/trusted-proxy calculation with the existing request-level locality decision and prove matching acceptance behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause the pre-handshake gate
options.body: Keep current post-handshake enforcement until gateway owners define and test a distinct pre-upgrade locality contract.

recommendation.title: Port the canonical locality contract
recommendation.body: Replace the reduced loopback/trusted-proxy calculation with the existing request-level locality decision and prove matching acceptance behavior before merge.
